name: Hong Kong
tagline: English-taught, IB-literate, and the early rounds close in November
summary: Hong Kong's universities teach in English and read the IB directly. A Danish student is a non-local applicant: you apply to each university on its own site, not through JUPAS. The early rounds close in November 2026, on predicted grades. Fees are high, about HK$250,000 to 280,000 a year at HKU.
whyConsider: HKU, CUHK and HKUST teach in English and take the IB as a standard qualification.
Several universities keep applications open after IB results day. HKU closes on 25 August 2027.
watchOuts: The first rounds close from 12 November 2026 (CUHK) to 25 November (HKU, HKUST). Most places are decided there, on predicted grades.
Each university is a separate application, with its own fee and its own dates.
CityU's admissions pages block automated reading, so its dates are not recorded here. Check them yourself.

notes: Offers made on predicted grades are conditional on the final diploma.

language.englishTaughtBachelors: Most programmes at the main universities.
language.englishProof: The IB is normally accepted. Check each university.

feeContext.summary: Hong Kong has no EU category. A Danish student is non-local and pays the non-local fee.
HKU 2027/28: HK$280,000 a year in STEM faculties and HK$250,000 in the others.

sectorLandscape.summary: Eight universities are funded by the University Grants Committee (UGC). Beside them are the Academy for Performing Arts, which is publicly funded outside the UGC, and a group of self-financing universities. Below degree level, associate degrees and higher diplomas are a large route of their own.

routes.what: HKU, CUHK, HKUST, PolyU, CityU, HKBU, Lingnan and EdUHK. These are the universities most students mean by Hong Kong. Each admits non-local students directly, on its own dates.

routes.localName: The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts
routes.what: Degrees in dance, drama, music, film and theatre production. Admission is by audition or portfolio.
routes.note: Its admissions pages were not read in detail.

routes.what: Hang Seng University, Metropolitan University, Shue Yan University and THEi. Degree-awarding, without recurrent government funding, and more career-focused than the UGC eight.
routes.note: Their entry for non-local IB students was not researched.

routes.what: Two-year programmes at community colleges and institution-linked schools. Many Hong Kong students use them to top up into a degree later. This is the route foreign guides never mention.
routes.note: Named so the route is visible. Not researched.

notes: Written to the publication floor by the Greece, China and Hong Kong pass on 2026-09-23. One direct route covers every institution because every one of them admits non-local students directly.

Not established: CityU's dates (the site blocks bots), and the dates at HKBU, Lingnan, EdUHK, HKAPA and the self-financing universities. The Concourse site (cspe.edu.hk) renders its institution list in JavaScript and serves a broken TLS chain.
